units.source: Note Map (Link map, Tree map)
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map)

units.source: Note map is a visualization of connections between notes. This provides an insight into a structure ("web") of notes.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map)

units.source: There are two types of note map:
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map)

units.source: Link Map, which shows relations between notes.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map)

units.source: Note Map, which shows the hierarchical tree structure.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map)

units.source: Accessing the note map__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Accessing the note map

units.source: The note map comes into multiple flavors:
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Accessing the note map

units.source: The note map is available in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Connections tab__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Right Sidebar__TRILIUM_PH_3__, in the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Note map__TRILIUM_PH_5__ section.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Accessing the note map

units.source: It can also be accessed by going to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note map__TRILIUM_PH_3__, which will focus the sidebar at the right section.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Accessing the note map

units.source: To display a full-screen note map, there is a __TRILIUM_PH_0__dedicated note type__TRILIUM_PH_1__ with the same name.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Accessing the note map

units.source: To view the global note map (of all the notes in the knowledge base), there is a dedicated __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note map__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Accessing the note map

units.source: Terminology and structure__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Terminology and structure

units.source: Each note is represented as a __TRILIUM_PH_0__node__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in the graph, with the title displayed underneath.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Terminology and structure

units.source: When the map is zoomed out, the title can still be viewed by hovering over the node.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Terminology and structure

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__icon and color__TRILIUM_PH_1__ of the note are respected.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Terminology and structure

units.source: The root node is the reference point for which the relations and hierarchical structure are displayed.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Terminology and structure

units.source: When accessing the note map through the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Right Sidebar__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the root node is the current note.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Terminology and structure

units.source: When using a dedicated __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Map__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note, the root note can be either the parent note, the currently __TRILIUM_PH_2__hoisted__TRILIUM_PH_3__ note or a specific note. See the note type documentation for more information.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Terminology and structure

units.source: Interaction__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Interaction

units.source: Nodes can be dragged around, but they will return to their original position once released.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Interaction

units.source: To have the notes remain in the same position as they were dragged, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Fix nodes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button. The position of the notes is not saved, so it will return to normal once you navigate to another note or restart the application.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Interaction

units.source: When hovering over a node, the adjacent relations and nodes are highlighted.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Interaction

units.source: The distance between nodes can be adjusted via the slider in the bottom-left. Similarly, this value is not saved.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Interaction

units.source: To zoom, use the mouse wheel, pinch on a touch screen, or press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ and __TRILIUM_PH_1__ buttons in the bottom-right corner.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Interaction

units.source: To bring the whole map back into view, press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Fit to view__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button next to them.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Interaction

units.source: The zoom buttons are not shown on mobile, where pinching zooms instead. The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Fit to view__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button is always shown.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Interaction

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Archived Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ are generally ignored by the note map in order to reduce clutter. There is one exception: if the root note is also archived, then all archived notes are displayed too.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Interaction

units.source: Link Map__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Link Map

units.source: The link map is a visualization of links and __TRILIUM_PH_0__Relations__TRILIUM_PH_1__ incoming to and outgoing from a particular note.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Link Map

units.source: The map indicates the following types of relations:
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Link Map

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Internal (reference) links__TRILIUM_PH_1__ between notes.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Link Map

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Relations__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Link Map

units.source: The link map will also show unlinked notes that are part of the hierarchy as a cloud of unconnected dots. On the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Right Sidebar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ deliberately omits this in order to save some space, but they will be revealed once the map is maximized.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Link Map

units.source: Tree Map__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Tree Map

units.source: Shows hierarchical map of notes:
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > Tree Map

units.source: See also__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > See also

units.source: Apart from the note map feature which can be accessed from any note, it is also possible to create a dedicated note which will display the relations in full screen. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Map__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for more information.
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > See also

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Relation Map__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is a similar concept, with some differences:
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > See also

units.source: note map is automatically generated while relation map must be created manually
units.context: Note Map (Link map, Tree map) > See also

units.source: relation map is a type of note while a link map is just virtual visualization
